rules.zh: 固定表達 nothing short of 可接形容詞或名詞來作強烈評價；short 不能改成副詞 shortly，介詞 of 也不能改成 than 或 from。
rules.en: nothing short of nothing short of remarkable nothing short of a miracle nothing shortly of remarkable nothing short than remarkable nothing short from remarkable

rules.zh: 形容詞前不使用 a 或 an 但是，當後面是單數可數名詞時，通常需要 a 或 an：【The result was nothing short of a miracle.】
rules.en: The result was nothing short of remarkable. The result was nothing short of a remarkable. The result was nothing short of a miracle. The decision was nothing short of an insult.

rules.zh: 不可數名詞或抽象名詞通常不使用冠詞
rules.en: nothing short of chaos nothing short of negligence nothing short of genius nothing short of cruelty

rules.zh: 動詞可以按照時態和主詞改變的固定部分不會改變。
rules.en: be The achievement is nothing short of extraordinary. The achievements are nothing short of extraordinary. The achievement was nothing short of extraordinary. The achievement has been nothing short of extraordinary. The achievement could be nothing short of extraordinary. nothing short of

rules.zh: 這是一種強烈表達不只是普通描述。它表示說話者認為某事完全達到某種程度，而且通常令人驚訝、佩服、震驚或不滿。普通描述：【The recovery was remarkable.】 這次康復情況十分出色。 更強烈的描述：【The recovery was nothing short of remarkable.】 這次康復情況簡直令人驚嘆。 因此，不應把這個句型用於不需要強調的普通小事。
rules.en: nothing short of The recovery was remarkable. The recovery was nothing short of remarkable.

rules.zh: 可用於正面或負面評價正面：（Positive；這場表演簡直精彩絕倫。 負面：（Negative）；這次延誤簡直令人無法接受。）
rules.en: The performance was nothing short of brilliant. The delay was nothing short of unacceptable.

rules.zh: 不要與其他含 short 的結構混淆缺錢 未能達到期望 簡直非同凡響 三者的意思和用法不同。
rules.en: short of money fall short of expectations nothing short of extraordinary

benefits.zh: 能清楚而有力地表達評價這個句型告訴讀者，你並非只認為某事「有一點」出色、嚴重或令人失望，而是認為它完全達到該程度。這項應對措施很好。 這項應對措施簡直非同凡響。 第二句的態度明顯更強烈。
benefits.en: It gives your opinion strong and clear emphasis The response was good. The response was nothing short of extraordinary.

benefits.zh: 能代替較長的解釋你可以用一個簡潔句型，代替以下較長的說法：【It can only be described as remarkable.】 較精簡的版本是：【It was nothing short of remarkable.】
benefits.en: It can replace a longer explanation It can only be described as remarkable. It was so remarkable that ordinary words could not describe it. It was nothing short of remarkable.

benefits.zh: 可以靈活配合形容詞及名詞你可以直接強調一種特質：【nothing short of amazing；nothing short of irresponsible】 也可以把事情形容為某種情況或行為：【nothing short of a miracle；nothing short of an insult；nothing short of negligence】 因此，這個句型能表達多種正面和負面評價。
benefits.en: It works with both adjectives and nouns nothing short of amazing nothing short of irresponsible nothing short of a miracle nothing short of an insult nothing short of negligence

benefits.zh: 能突出重要觀點在演說、評論、報告、故事或議論文中，這個句型可以把讀者的注意力帶到最值得重視的評價。這句不只是說明「有人沒有檢查大橋」，還清楚表明作者認為問題極為嚴重。
benefits.en: It helps important points stand out The failure to inspect the bridge was nothing short of gross negligence.

benefits.zh: 能增加句式變化這個表達不需要永遠放在簡單句的結尾。它可以出現在：主句；以【that】為例：子句；詞語【although】或 if 子句；關係子句；結構；目標表達【seem, prove, feel】等連繫動詞之後。這能避免所有句子都使用完全相同的結構。
benefits.en: It gives you more sentence variety describe...as seem, prove, feel
